newsitem.title: PERU: Peru traffickers use witchcraft to avoid capture.
newsitem.headline: Peru traffickers use witchcraft to avoid capture.

text.p: Peruvian drug-traffickers are turning to witchcraft to avoid capture -- but not always with successful results.

Officials in the drug-growing jungle region were surprised to find this week inside a shipment of 440 pounds (200 kg) of coca paste a Voodoo-style doll representing a policeman with his hands tied, eyes shut and nails stuck to the body.

Milanio Vargas, 61, who was arrested on the boat carrying the drug, said the doll was his "insurance" against being caught during transport, according to local media. ft and drug-trafficking are common in this South American nation, which leads the world in production of coca leaf, the raw product for cocaine.
